His practice covers coronary bypass on both the beating and arrested heart, aortic and mitral valve repair and replacement, and congenital repairs including ASD and VSD closure. He has a particular focus on aortic surgery, including the Bentall procedure, valve-sparing root replacement, hemiarch and total arch replacement, and thoracoabdominal aneurysm repair. His practice also covers robotic surgery for oesophageal, lung, pancreatic, colorectal, prostate, bladder and kidney cancer. He holds an MBBS, an MS in General Surgery and a DNB in Surgical Oncology.

His practice covers breast, lung and gastrointestinal cancers and blood disorders, using chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy and precision oncology. He is lead author on the largest real-world Indian dataset on targeted therapy in head and neck cancer, and previously directed medical oncology and haemato-oncology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket.

He is trained across the advanced radiotherapy techniques, including intensity-modulated and image-guided radiotherapy, gated and adaptive treatment, stereotactic radiosurgery and stereotactic body radiotherapy. His work centres on advanced cardiac imaging, structural heart disease and preventive cardiology, and he is a fellow of the American College of Cardiology, the American Society of Echocardiography and the American Heart Association.

He completed his MBBS at Gauhati Medical College, his MD in General Medicine at SMS Medical College, Jaipur, and his DNB in Gastroenterology at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, Delhi. His practice covers transplant hepatology, endoscopic ultrasound and diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, and he has more than 40 publications.

bio: Dr. Ashok Rajgopal is Group Chairman of the Medanta Institute of Musculoskeletal Disorders and Orthopaedics, Gurugram, and has performed around 40,000 total knee replacements along with more than 60,000 arthroscopic operations for sports injuries. He performed India's first bilateral total knee replacement, its first minimally invasive joint replacement, its first virtual total knee replacement using patient-specific instrumentation, and was the first in the country to use gender-specific knee implants. He designed and patented instruments for minimally invasive knee replacement that are now used by surgeons internationally. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2014.

He completed his MBBS at Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar, his MD in Internal Medicine and DM in Cardiology at B.J. Medical College, Gujarat University, and his DNB in Cardiology in 1994. He was Haryana's first DM-qualified cardiologist, opened the state's first dedicated heart hospital in 2002, and founded SSB Heart and Multispeciality Hospital in 2020. He trained in stress and transoesophageal echocardiography at the Mayo Clinic and in angioplasty in Germany, and is a fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions and of the American College of Cardiology.

His practice spans mechanical thrombectomy for acute stroke, aneurysm coiling and embolisation, intracranial and carotid angioplasty, cerebral arteriovenous malformation and dural fistula embolisation, and transcranial Doppler monitoring for vasospasm. He has extensive experience in reconstructive surgery in neonates and infants and favours early corrective repair wherever it is possible. He has performed more than 15,000 thoracic operations, over 8,000 of them by minimally invasive or robotic technique, and led North India's first double lung transplant, at Medanta in November 2022. name: Dr. Ashok Seth
bio: Dr. Ashok Seth chairs Fortis Escorts Heart Institute, New Delhi, and the Fortis Healthcare Medical Council, and has practised interventional cardiology for around four decades. He has performed more than 60,000 angiographies and 25,000 angioplasties, and was the first in Asia to perform several procedures, among them coronary stenting, drug-eluting stents, angioscopy, Angiojet thrombectomy, Impella support, TAVR and bioresorbable scaffolds. He is an adjunct professor of cardiology at JN Medical College, Aligarh Muslim University, and at the National Board of Examinations. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2003, the Padma Bhushan in 2015, and the Dr. B.C. Roy National Award in 2017.

name: Dr. Sabhyata Gupta
bio: Dr. Sabhyata Gupta chairs the division of gynaecology and gynaecologic oncology at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, with more than 30 years in obstetrics, gynaecology and gynaecologic oncology. She completed her MBBS at Government Medical College, Jammu, in 1987, her MD in 1991, and a diploma in gynaecological endoscopic surgery in Kiel, Germany. She was the first gynaecologist in India to perform robotic gynaecological surgery for both cancerous and benign conditions, and has trained many gynaecologists in laparoscopic and robotic technique. Her practice also covers advanced gynaecological laparoscopy, hysteroscopy and colposcopy. She is a member of the International Gynaecologic Cancer Society and the European Society of Gynaecological Oncology.
